Name: Multiplayer shaft fix
Author: PrinceLeto
Description:
Now fixed in Stardew Valley 1.4


Have you played Stardew Valley in multiplayer in the Skull Cavern? Have you jump into the holes?
You may have noticed that you don't fall the same number of floors that your friends, and everybody may be separated.
I found that very annoying, so I made a mod to fix it.

With this mod, the number of floors you fall when you jump into a shaft is deterministic, depending on the current day and the current level. It means that you and your friends will fall the same number of levels.
The randomness probabilities are preserved, you can still fall from 3 to 15 levels.

Every player needs the mod to make it work. If you don't have it, you will fall a different number of floors, but there is no incompatibility issue.

Working versions of Stardew Valley:
- 1.3.33
- 1.3.32
- 1.3.28

Windows and linux version are available. Untested on macOS, you may try the linux version.

Installation:
- Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]SMAPI[/url]
- Unzip this mod to the mods folder

[url=https://github.com/gregoirechauvet/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
